provenance.record: Canonical source export for the animated runtime derivative. Preserve its editable Blender project, source animation archive and runtime validation records together under art/characters/.

The recovery instructions reference Git commit 6cd9f6fcdf3bc66997e03d28439bc22c019b427e, which preserves assets/game.scene/, assets/main-menu.scene/ and src/game/presentation/fit-menu-logo.ts before the static protagonist and Babylon title were retired. The duplicate local scene archive was removed; active scenes remain under assets/.

Active art, exact prompts, generation/validation records, Blender sources and available source-asset licensing are organised under art/. Retired reference inputs and removed sources are recoverable as documented in docs/plans/3d-cleanup.md.
